title: Model ML Partners with Harmonic to Bring Startup Discovery Data Into Model ML - Model ML
summary: Model ML partners with Harmonic: search startup, people and investor data via MCP for deal sourcing, market maps and target lists inside Model ML.
body_markdown:
We're excited to announce[Harmonic](https://harmonic.ai/) , the startup discovery engine that investors use to find and track companies, as the newest member of Model ML’s partnership network.


Venture, growth and corporate development teams use Harmonic to source deals, get alerts on companies gaining momentum, track headcount and hiring, and find warm introductions through their team’s network. Its data goes past founders and the C-suite to the engineers, designers, product managers and operators whose moves signal where a company is heading. Scout, Harmonic’s AI agent, automates research from discovery to decision.


Through MCP, Model ML users can now search Harmonic for companies, people and investors, enrich target lists, and pull from saved searches and their team’s network without leaving Model ML. A sourcing screen, market map or target profile can be built on live Harmonic data, with no exports between tools.


Live now for all Model ML users with a Harmonic license.
